## About this Website 

This is the third iteration of the *Introduction to Open Data* course and the second in website format. Originally created as a Markdown-based presentation [@raemyIntroductionOpenData2024], the course was first adapted into a website and now continues to evolve. While the core content from the original presentation remains valuable, this version introduces a restructured approach to hopefully better serve learners' needs. 

This Quarto-based site maintains essential concepts while offering improved layout, accessibility, and the capacity for ongoing refinement as the open data landscape develops.

## About the Instructor

Julien A. Raemy is a Cultural Heritage and Digital Preservation Expert. He currently works as a Semantic Architect and Digital Archiving Project Manager at docuteam. He also holds an appointment as an Associate Researcher in Digital Humanities at the University of Bern (Walter Benjamin Kolleg). He has worked extensively in academia and in or for the cultural heritage domain and is an active member of [Linked Art](https://linked.art), the [International Image Interoperability Framework (IIIF)](https://iiif.io), as well as the [Archival Resource Key (ARK) Alliance](https://arks.org/).
